snapshot_date_basis: GTFS folder gtfs_20251003_180717, calendar start_date values; published archive 2026-08-06 contains historical snapshot, not current route feed.
agency_interpretation: Selected route agency_id cells are blank. Raw routes encode variants in route_id, but distinct operator identity cannot be inferred from numeric prefixes. Blank agency_id is permitted here because there is a single agency row.
duplicate_interpretation: Keep route_id as the key; matching short names can represent distinct route variants. A duplicate short name alone is not proof of a different operator or year.
calendar_rules: Weekly monday-sunday service between start_date and end_date inclusive, then calendar_dates additions(1) and removals(2). Dates are local service dates in Australia/Melbourne.
time_scope_limit: Scheduled service-day coverage only, not proof each trip operated or loaded passengers. No real-time history.
pattern_scope_limit: This independent audit groups route_id + direction_id + shape_id; exact stop-sequence pattern audit remains the parent derivation.
